params.caption: 🕹️ Switch 2 and Switch get firmware 23.5.0, paving the way for eShop gifting Nintendo has rolled out system update 23.5.0 to every Switch and Switch 2. Its main change prepares consoles for an upcoming update that will let members of a Nintendo Account family group gift games to each other — a feature Nintendo is quietly bringing back. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 12:22 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #Nintendo #Switch2 #GamingNews
